extracted.intended_audience: aspiring authors and illustrators querying Curtis Brown, Ltd.; writers seeking literary-agent submission guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Agency-specific instructions for authors (adult and children’s) and illustrators submitting work to Curtis Brown, Ltd., including scope, mailing requirements, prohibited formats, fees, and anti-scam guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Curtis Brown represents adult and children’s authors of all genres, including illustrators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check individual agent interests and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Please refer to our Agents page for information about each agent’s interests, specific submission requirements and individual email addresses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consult the Agents page to determine which agent is appropriate and to follow any agent-specific submission instructions (format, length, email vs. mail, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mail submissions: include stamped self-addressed envelope and return postage
rubrics_metrics.description: If the agent accepts submissions via mail, please enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope for a response, and return postage if you wish to have your materials returned to you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope (SASE) for a response; add return postage if you want materials returned. Without a SASE, the agency may not be able to return materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to address mailed submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please clearly address your envelope as follows: Attn: Agent’s Name Curtis Brown, Ltd. 228 East 45th Street, Suite 310 New York, NY 10017
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified address format and include 'Attn: Agent’s Name' so the submission reaches the intended agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: No reading or editorial fees
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not charge reading fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curtis Brown, Ltd. does not charge reading or editorial fees of any kind. Authors should be wary of anyone requesting payment to read or represent their work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format exclusions / not accepted material
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not handle stage plays or musicals. We are not accepting screenplay submissions at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit stage plays, musicals, or (currently) screenplays to this agency; follow the Agents page for any agent-specific exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return policy for submissions without SASE
rubrics_metrics.description: We regret that we cannot guarantee the return of submissions sent without a self-addressed, stamped envelope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you wish your materials returned, include a SASE and return postage; otherwise materials may not be returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti-scam / verification policy
rubrics_metrics.description: No Curtis Brown agent will reach out to an author with an offer from a publisher unless the author is already represented by Curtis Brown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are contacted by someone claiming association with Curtis Brown and you suspect fraud, email [email protected] with the subject line: Confirming Email Status.
